statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptoms
The service was ordered to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
